name: WeBase HAKATA Hostel
detail: I used a 4-person room with bunk beds. The room was very clean. The shower room and powder room were also hygienic. Breakfast included bread, jam, yogurt, cereal, milk, coffee, and juice. It takes about a 20-minute walk to Marine Messe. I'm very satisfied with the price and everything. One point: I requested earplugs and room wear at the front desk to be left in my room, but they weren't there. However, I was able to sleep soundly. I will stay here again during the next live event.

name: UNPLAN Fukuoka
detail: After the LIVE at PayPay Dome Recommended points The location is unbeatable and the luggage storage is excellent. A clean sheet with a sleep environment where you won’t be bothered by sounds or lights next door. Delicious coffee served at breakfast ☀️🍴 Considerations There’s a huge crowd in the shower room. Having toilet sandals or slippers makes using the restroom easier. It’s expensive, but that’s expected after the LIVE. I would like to use it again 😊

name: APA Hotel Hakataeki Chikushiguchi
detail: I stayed for a concert. It was less than a 10-minute walk from Hakata Station's Chikushi Exit, and the location was convenient with a convenience store nearby. I arrived before 3 PM to drop off my luggage, but I was able to enter the room, so I was grateful to be able to relax in the room for a bit. The large public bath was clean, and there were tub baths and an outdoor bath, so I could enjoy a nice bath. The price was also reasonable, and it will be a regular option when I come to Fukuoka.

name: The Millennials Fukuoka
detail: Overall summary: Pros: 1. Clean and comfortable. 2. The bed area is quite spacious horizontally, so even though it's a capsule, it doesn't feel cramped at all. 3. Amenities provided. 4. The restrooms and shower rooms are pleasant and well-maintained, with a new construction feel. 5. Each shower stall has a changing space in between, making it convenient to leave clothes and change. 6. All the staff are very friendly. 7. The lobby is pretty and comfortable, making it a good workspace. 8. The shared space with Lively Hotel makes the walk feel safe. Cons: If I had to point some out: 1. There is storage space under the bed, but it doesn't fit a small suitcase. If you stand the suitcase in front of the bed, it conflicts with the blinds. Leaving luggage outside the blinds seems risky for theft. 2. As of early June, the air conditioning was too cold... The blanket was also a thin sheet, so it didn't keep warm well. Since it was summer, I didn't have warm outerwear to wear, and I was worried about catching a cold. 3. It might be difficult for someone sensitive to noise? Footsteps, and the sound of the blinds (though it's quiet). Anyway, I am very, very satisfied considering the price. If the purpose is just to sleep, it's the best place for a day or two! However, I don't think it's suitable for a long stay.

name: APA Hotel Hakata Gion Ekimae
detail: 1. It was cheaper than other accommodations around, but maybe because it's vacation season, it felt expensive. 2. The staff were very kind. 3. It was convenient that they provided self check-in instructions in Korean. 4. It was good for security that you had to swipe the card to get on the elevator. 5. There's a Lawson convenience store right next to it and a FamilyMart across the street, making it convenient for snacks or water. 6. It is within walking distance from Hakata. 7. It is walkable to Canal Way and Nakasu. 8. It was perfect for solo stay. I could open my suitcase and use it comfortably. 9. The lobby is really cool. It's cool enough to make me happy, but it gets hot on the way to the room after taking the elevator [though it's not far, so it's manageable]. 10. I had to shower in the bathtub, but the shower curtain had a smell... However, it's manageable if you ventilate well. If I come to Fukuoka again, I would like to book this accommodation again if asked. 🫡🫡

name: 9h nine hours Hakata station
detail: I used a capsule hotel for the first time, and it was more comfortable than I had expected. The access from the station was good, and the hotel was very clean. The capsule itself was comfortable for sleeping, and I was able to rest well. It was located in the city, and even though it was fully booked on the day I stayed, I was surprised at how quiet it was! At first, it was too quiet...! to the point that I felt a bit nervous, but I was able to relax without worrying about others around me. The showers were in private changing areas, so I could take my time and shower or change without being concerned about others, which was comfortable. Since the design meant that I didn't have to interact face-to-face with staff, I was able to use the facilities at my own pace, which was nice. The lounge had many people using it, but most seemed to be there alone, which created a very calm atmosphere. The background music and space were pleasant, making it a nice time to spend quietly. This time, there were very few vacant rooms overall in Hakata, and hotel rates had risen quite a bit, so the capsule hotel rates were a bit higher than usual. However, it seems that there are days during weekdays in the off-season when you can stay for a lower rate, so considering this cleanliness, comfort, and pleasant sleeping conditions, I think the price is quite reasonable. If I have the opportunity to stay alone again, I would definitely want to use this capsule hotel again!

name: APA Hotel & Resort Hakata Ekihigashi
detail: It's a bit of a walk from Hakata Station, but it can be reached in within 5 minutes, and it's in a safe location. The hotel facilities are very clean and convenient. The staff is also friendly and communication is smooth. During check-in/check-out times, many people gather and the lines get long. The washing machine is located inside the bath, so you have to enter the large bath area to find it.

name: Epoch inn Nakasu
detail: The location behind Don Quijote in Nakasu is superb. I was initially worried about the unmanned hotel, but I was able to connect to the front desk through the tablet at the entrance and check in smoothly. The facilities were new and felt clean. The downside was that the large TV was facing the narrow side of the room, making it a bit difficult to see.

name: TOWER HOTEL
detail: It’s a new hotel, so it has great cost performance, and it’s incredibly spacious and nice! The bathroom is very spacious, and the bedroom is also very large. I’m very satisfied!! The staff are very friendly, and since I had an early morning flight, I checked out at dawn and requested a taxi; they called one for me and checked on me until I left. It’s excellent for unpacking luggage as well. The downside is that the room lock is still a key, and it makes a bit of noise when moving around? It’s a bit far from Tianjin and Hakata, but public transportation is available. It’s a perfect accommodation.

name: APA Hotel Fukuoka Tenjinnishi
detail: The location was easily accessible on foot and convenient for shopping. The accommodation had good hot water supply and the bathroom was clean, allowing for a pleasant stay. The housekeeping service was also very satisfactory. The staff's attitude was friendly, and the overall facilities were well-equipped, making for a comfortable time.
